title: Multisymmetric functions on eventually constant cyclic graphs
summary: The study of spanning trees and related structures is central in graph theory, closely connected to understanding functions between finite sets. This paper generalizes the established relationship between rooted trees and eventually constant endomorphisms to a wider context including $k$-tuples of functions among $k$ disjoint vertex sets. We derive a weighted count of eventually constant $k$-tuples, which are characterized by their stabilization to constancy upon iterated composition.
